name: Ankoku-jou ~Souzou-shin Gyarian no Fukkatsu~
original_name: 暗黒城 ～創造神ギャリアンの復活～
source:
The game is an adventure part of the series of jrpg games. Dark apostle wants to become the ruler of the world with the help of legendary mirror of Laval.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作是《密涅瓦顿传说》系列的一部冒险游戏。暗黑使徒古鲁企图摧毁传说中的“拉瓦尔之镜”，从而成为世界的统治者。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
